name: POS
recent: Pos Malaysia 在2026年11月16日公布截至2026年9月30日的第三季度业绩，净亏损扩大至6230万令吉，尽管营收同比增长8%。公司表示复苏取决于政府的邮政改革，亏损已延续33个季度。此外，公司于2026年8月21日更换公司秘书。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日的第三季度业绩，净亏损6230万令吉。
更换公司秘书，由LEE SIEW YOKE接任。
risks: 第三季度净亏损扩大至6230万令吉，亏损已延续33个季度。
公司表示复苏取决于政府的邮政改革。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为4.813亿令吉，环比下降4%，同比增长9%；净亏损4346万令吉，净利率为-9.0%，较上一季度的-3.9%扩大。

recent_en: Pos Malaysia announced its 3Q results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026, with net loss widening to RM62.3 million despite 8% revenue growth. The company said recovery hinges on government postal reforms, with losses extending to 33 quarters. Separately, the company changed its company secretary on 21 August 2026.
notable_en: Announced 3Q results for the period ended 30 September 2026 with a net loss of RM62.3 million.
Changed company secretary, with LEE SIEW YOKE appointed.
risks_en: 3Q net loss widened to RM62.3 million, with losses extending to 33 quarters.
The company said recovery depends on government postal reforms.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM481.3 million, down 4% QoQ but up 9% YoY; net loss was RM43.5 million with a net margin of -9.0%, widening from -3.9% in the previous quarter.
